correctness.rationale: Exact four-by-four Boolean de Bruijn relation matrices encode a cyclic predecessor if and only if their labeled product has nonzero diagonal. Reachability closure gives 83 and 34 states. Both exact-integer deterministic counting systems certify their stated order-four recurrences with 83 and 34 distinct scalar equations; Cayley–Hamilton extends each beyond the finite check. Correct initial values give both rational generating functions, and algebra proves the Tribonacci–Lucas parity law. Two standalone programs passed directly from the package; exhaustive source-input enumeration to length 16 supplements but does not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The precise number of reachable outputs is a natural information-loss invariant for the well-studied selective-copier CA Rule 172, where prior research motivates preimage and finite-size questions. The result gives an infinite all-length closed formula, an exact growth exponent, and a non-obvious parity equality with nonidentical Rule-184 output sets. It is not merely adding a few terms or a direct textbook corollary; the nonstandard 83-state cyclic relation certificate and global comparison are substantive. The finding is limited to one step and does not claim a larger dynamical classification.
